title: Page 29
transc:
No 7. NY
John Horner NY ( 9 )  Washington Apr 6th 1864 12 M
Pagan Gertrude April For Vienna
Van Vleet Vinton Merlin Your despatch
of fifth and sixth in relation
to Steamers received period Despatch to
Hil = ton Head as soon as
storm permits enough Steamers to move
with ease six thou sand men
period This Stagger to be in
addition to the steamers now at
Hil = ton Head or engaged regularly
in running to and fro period
It is under stood here that
enough stomach is at command of
Vermin Gill = more to move five
thous = and men and their Baggage
and land stagger period I wish
to add from Midas stomach for
six thous = and more period The
colored youth at Annapolis will move
on Steamers ordered from this place
and from the Chesapeake period Report
the vessels you engage & their
capacity & time of sailing period
Keep this secret and advise me
of progress making sig Meigs Aragon
Tell him to telegraph in cipher
